title: Production authoritative query APIs, derivative Search integration, consistent snapshots, pagination, and opt-in CLI
invariants_verified: Independently durable Context without raw repository file body archival
Reconstructible Search without recovery-stop on derivative loss or corruption
Unified read APIs supporting single-store and paired catalogs
Consistent pinned snapshot fencing across readers and concurrent writers
Deterministic cursor-based pagination failing closed on snapshot mismatch
Transparent fallback from stale/corrupt Search projection to authoritative scan
Verification-aware byte reads halting immediately on detected authoritative corruption
Exclusion of ordinary file blobs from search indexing
Isolated opt-in CLI preserving Schema 21 default main CLI
